guide: Open Start and type your agency name and your own rules in the yellow cells: your fee, the fees for usage rights and exclusivity, the engagement you call good and the weights for fit.
Fill Brand Clients with one row for each brand. Campaigns, budget, money committed to creators and sales from codes fill in from the other pages.
Keep Rate Card up to date with the low and high price for a post on every platform and creator size. The typical price and the average ask of your creators fill in.
Add every creator on Creators with followers, engagement rate and asking rate. The price check tells you at once if the rate is above or below the rate card.
Track every creator you approach on Outreach Pipeline. The next step shows who needs a follow up, and the gap shows how far your offer is from their ask.
Write each campaign on Campaign Briefs with its budget, then record each creator agreement on Contracts. Usage fee, exclusivity fee, your fee, the usage end date and the money still owed fill in.
List every post a creator owes on Deliverables and every draft on Content Approvals. Days late, days waiting and the status fill in.
Record every deposit and final payment on Creator Payments. Overdue payments, money owed and the days late fill in.
Score each live post on Creator Results with its reach and reactions to see the engagement rate, the cost for each engagement and the cost for 1000 people reached.
Add each code or tracked link on Codes and Links to see commission, discount cost, sales for each unit spent and the net result.
Use Brand Fit, Follower Audits, Ad Label Checks and Exclusivity before you sign and after each post, and Creator Feedback after each campaign.
Use Gifted Products, Event Appearances and Ambassadors for the other ways you work with creators.

Use the 14 calculators for rates, cost per engagement, return, fit, commission, usage rights, payment schedules, budget split, reach, gifting, exclusivity, shortlists, real audience cost and ambassadors.
Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 10 step-by-step checklists and tap a message link to open WhatsApp with the text ready.
Read Creators Dashboard and Charts every week: overdue posts and payments, usage rights ending, ad label checks, budget and results.

listing.title: Social Media Management Creators and Partnerships Excel Template: Creator Database, Contracts, Payments, Results, Ad Labels
listing.headline: Run creator campaigns, contracts and payments for every brand you manage
listing.description:
Run creator and influencer work for every brand you manage in one Excel workbook. Creators holds your database with followers, engagement and asking rate, and a price check compares each rate with your own Rate Card so you see who is expensive and who is a good deal.

Outreach Pipeline tracks every message from first contact to agreement with a follow up warning, and Campaign Briefs sets a budget for each campaign and shows what is committed, paid and left. Contracts works out usage rights, exclusivity, your fee, the date the rights end and the money still owed, and Exclusivity flags clashes before you sign a second brand. Deliverables, Content Approvals and Creator Payments show late posts, slow approvals and overdue payments.

Creator Results turns reach and reactions into engagement rate, cost for each engagement and cost for 1000 people reached. Codes and Links work out commission, discount cost and the sales for each unit spent. Ad Label Checks, Follower Audits and Brand Fit protect you and your clients before and after every post, and Gifted Products, Event Appearances, Ambassadors and Creator Feedback cover every other way you work with creators.

14 calculators cover rates, cost per engagement, return, fit, commission, usage rights, payment schedules, budget split, reach, gifting, exclusivity, shortlists, real audience cost and ambassadors. Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 10 checklists and send 29 WhatsApp messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part seven of the Social Media Management suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for 30 brands to explore first. It helps you plan your work and does not promise results.

messages.text: Hi {name}, we love your content and would like to work with you for {brand}. Can we send you a short brief and our offer?
Hi {name}, a quick follow up on our message {days_open} days ago about a paid collaboration for {brand}. Are you open to it?
Hi {name}, our offer for {brand} is {offer}. Your ask is {ask}. Can we meet in the middle?
Hi {name}, your contract {ct_id} for {brand} is ready: {posts} posts for {fee}, total {total} with the rights. Please sign and send it back.
Hi {name}, the usage rights in contract {ct_id} for {brand} end on {usage_end} ({days_left} days). Do you agree to extend them?
Hi {name}, for contract {ct_id} we still owe you {owed}. We will pay it on the agreed date.
Hi {name}, your post "{title}" for {brand} is due on {due} ({days_left} days). Can you confirm the date?
Hi {name}, the post "{title}" for {brand} was due on {due}. Can you post today and send us the link?
Thank you {name}, the post "{title}" is live. Please send us the reach and the reactions from your own numbers.
Hi {name}, we checked your draft "{title}" for {brand}. It is on round {rounds}. We will send our comments today.
Hi {name}, the draft "{title}" has waited {days_wait} days for approval. The post is due on {post_due}. We are chasing the client.
Hi {name}, your draft "{title}" is approved. You can post on {post_due}. Please keep the ad label in the first line.
Hi {name}, we paid {amount} ({kind}) for contract {contract}. Please confirm that it arrived.
Hi {name}, your {kind} of {amount} is due on {due}. Please check that your bank details are still correct.
Hi {name}, sorry, your {kind} of {amount} was due on {due}. We are paying it today.
Hi {name}, we sent you {product} ({qty} items) from {brand}. Please tell us when it arrives.
Hi {name}, it has been {days} days since we sent {product}. Did it arrive? We would love to see a post, with the ad label.
Hi {name}, your post "{title}" for {brand} passed {score} of 4 ad label checks. Please add a clear ad label in the first line today.
Hi {name}, your post "{title}" passed our ad label check. Thank you for the clear label.
Hi {name}, you are booked for the {kind} on {date} at {place} for {brand}. The fee is {fee}. Please confirm.
Hi {name}, a reminder: the event at {place} is in {days} days ({date}). Please send us your arrival time.
Hi {name}, you have posted {posts_done} times for {brand} and we planned {posts_month} each month. Can we plan the next posts?
Thank you {name} for {elapsed} months as an ambassador for {brand}. Your code {code} is working well.
Hi {name}, could you send screenshots of your audience statistics (countries, age and followers by day)? We need them to finish our check.
Hi {name}, thank you for the campaign for {brand}. We scored the work {avg} out of 5.
Hi {name}, would you like to work with us again for {brand}? We enjoyed the last campaign.
Hi, update for "{name}" ({brand}): {live} of {posts} posts are live and reached {reach} people. Budget left: {left}.
Hi {name}, we have a new campaign for a {niche} brand. Are you free next month? Your usual rate for a post is {rate}.
Hi, for {brand}: {campaigns} creator campaigns, {committed} committed to creators and {revenue} in sales from codes.

documents.title: Collaboration offer to a creator
paragraphs: Collaboration offer from {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Dear {col:op.name}, we would like to work with you for the brand {col:op.brand}. We offer {col:op.offer} for the work. Your ask was {col:op.ask}.
We will send a clear brief with the topic, the dates and the ad label you must use. You keep the creative control of your own style.
Please reply Yes if you are interested, or tell us what you need to agree.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Creator agreement
paragraphs: Agreement between {set:firm} and {col:ct.name}, dated {today}, for the brand {col:ct.brand}.
The creator will publish {col:ct.posts} posts for a fee of {col:ct.fee}. With usage rights and exclusivity the total is {col:ct.total}.
The creator uses a clear ad label on every post, sends each draft for approval before posting and publishes on the dates in the brief.
Payment follows the schedule on the payment pages. Both sides keep the terms private.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Usage rights letter
paragraphs: Usage rights letter from {set:firm}, dated {today}.
The brand {col:ct.brand} may use the content of {col:ct.name} under the rights: {col:ct.rights}. The use lasts {col:ct.usage_months} months and ends on {col:ct.usage_end}.
The creator agrees not to work with competing brands for {col:ct.excl_months} months. The usage fee is {col:ct.usage_fee} and the exclusivity fee is {col:ct.excl_fee}.
The content may not be used after the end date without a new agreement.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Campaign brief for creators
paragraphs: Creator brief for the campaign "{col:cb.name}", issued by {set:firm} on {today}.
Brand: {col:cb.brand}. Main platform: {col:cb.platform}. Goal: {col:cb.goal}. The campaign runs from {col:cb.start} to {col:cb.end}.
Show the product in a natural way, use the ad label in the first line, tag the brand and keep all claims true.
Send every draft for approval before you post. The owner of this campaign is {col:cb.owner}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Content approval request
paragraphs: Approval request from {set:firm}, dated {today}.
The draft "{col:ap.title}" by {col:ap.name} for {col:ap.brand} was sent on {col:ap.sent}. It has waited {col:ap.days_wait} days and is on round {col:ap.rounds}.
The post is due on {col:ap.post_due}. Please answer within {set:sla_days} days so that the date can stay.
Reply Approved, or tell us exactly what to change.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Payment advice to a creator
paragraphs: Payment advice from {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Dear {col:pay.name}, the {col:pay.kind} of {col:pay.amount} for contract {col:pay.contract} was due on {col:pay.due}. Status: {col:pay.state}.
We pay by {col:pay.method}. Please tell us if the amount or the details are not correct.
Thank you for your work.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Gift note with the request
paragraphs: Gift note from {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Dear {col:gf.name}, we sent you {col:gf.product} from {col:gf.brand}, value {col:gf.value}, on {col:gf.sent}.
There is no duty to post. If you do post, please use the ad label because the gift came from the brand, and tag the brand.
We would love to hear what you think.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Notice to fix an ad label
paragraphs: Ad label notice from {set:firm}, dated {today}.
We checked the post "{col:ds.title}" by {col:ds.name} for {col:ds.brand} on {col:ds.checked}. It passed {col:ds.score} of 4 checks. Result: {col:ds.state}.
The law and the rules of each platform ask for a clear ad label in the first line of every paid or gifted post. Please correct the post today.
Send us a screenshot when it is done.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Ambassador agreement
paragraphs: Ambassador agreement between {set:firm} and {col:am.name} for the brand {col:am.brand}, dated {today}.
Level: {col:am.level}. The programme runs {col:am.months} months from {col:am.start} to {col:am.end}. The fee is {col:am.fee_month} a month.
The creator publishes {col:am.posts_month} posts a month and shares the code {col:am.code}. Every post carries a clear ad label.
The agreement can end earlier by written notice.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Campaign report for the client
paragraphs: Creator campaign report for {col:cb.brand}, prepared by {set:firm} on {today}.
Campaign "{col:cb.name}": {col:cb.creators} creators, {col:cb.live} of {col:cb.posts} posts live, {col:cb.reach} people reached.
Budget {col:cb.budget}, committed {col:cb.committed}, paid {col:cb.paid}. Cost for 1000 people reached: {col:cb.cpm}. Budget check: {col:cb.state}.

ru.Open Start and type your agency name and: Откройте «Пуск» и введите название своего агентства и свои собственные правила в желтых ячейках: ваш гонорар, сборы за права использования и эксклюзивность, взаимодействие, которое вы считаете хорошим, и веса для соответствия.
ru.Fill Brand Clients with one row for each: Заполните Клиенты бренда одной строкой для каждого бренда. Кампании, бюджет, деньги, выделенные создателям контента, и продажи по кодам заполняются с других страниц.
ru.Keep Rate Card up to date with the low a: Держите Прейскурант в курсе низкой и высокой цены за публикацию для каждой платформы и размера создателя контента. Укажите типичную цену и средний запрос создателей вашего контента.
ru.Add every creator on Creators with follo: Добавьте каждого создателя контента в раздел «Создатели контента» с указанием подписчиков, уровня взаимодействия и количества запросов. Проверка цены сразу сообщит вам, находится ли ставка выше или ниже прейскуранта.
ru.Track every creator you approach on Outr: Отслеживайте каждого создателя контента, к которому вы обращаетесь на Информационно-пропагандистская программа. Следующий шаг показывает, кому нужна дополнительная помощь, а разрыв показывает, насколько далеко ваше предложение от их запроса.
ru.Write each campaign on Campaign Briefs w: Напишите для каждой кампании Креативные брифы для кампании ее бюджет, а затем запишите каждое соглашение с создателями контента в контрактах. Заполните плату за использование, плату за эксклюзивность, вашу комиссию, дату окончания использования и оставшуюся сумму задолженности.
ru.List every post a creator owes on Delive: Перечислите все публикации, которые автор контента должен получить, в разделе «Результаты» и каждый черновик в разделе «Утверждение контента». Дни опозданий, дни ожидания и заполнение статуса.
ru.Record every deposit and final payment o: Записывайте каждый депозит и окончательный платеж на Платежи создателям контента. Заполните просроченные платежи, задолженность по деньгам и дни просрочки.
ru.Score each live post on Creator Results: Оцените каждую действующую публикацию на Результаты создателя контента с учетом охвата аудитории и реакции, чтобы увидеть уровень взаимодействия, стоимость каждого взаимодействия и стоимость охвата 1000 человек.
ru.Add each code or tracked link on Codes a: Добавьте каждый код или отслеживаемую ссылку на Коды и ссылки, чтобы увидеть комиссию, стоимость скидки, продажи за каждую потраченную единицу и чистый результат.
ru.Use Brand Fit, Follower Audits, Ad Label: Используйте Подходит для бренда, Аудит последователей, Проверка рекламных ярлыков и эксклюзивность перед подписанием и после каждой публикации, а также Отзывы создателей контента после каждой кампании.
ru.Use Gifted Products, Event Appearances a: Используйте Подарочная продукция, Выступления на мероприятиях и Амбассадоры для других способов работы с создателями контента.
ru.Use the 14 calculators for rates, cost p: Используйте 14 калькуляторов для расчета ставок, стоимости взаимодействия, возврата, соответствия, комиссии, прав использования, графиков платежей, распределения бюджета, охвата аудитории, подарков, эксклюзивности, коротких списков, реальной стоимости аудитории и представителей.
ru.Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 1: Распечатайте 10 листов и 10 писем, следуйте 10 пошаговым контрольным спискам и коснитесь ссылки на сообщение, чтобы открыть WhatsApp с готовым текстом.
ru.Read Creators Dashboard and Charts every: Каждую неделю читайте Панель создателей контента и графики: просроченные публикации и платежи, прекращение прав на использование, проверки рекламных ярлыков, бюджет и результаты.
ru.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Все выпадающие списки книги. Измените пункт здесь — он обновится на всех листах.
ru.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Данные обновляются по вашим листам. Измените год, чтобы посмотреть прошлые периоды.
ru.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Выберите значение в жёлтой ячейке — остальные заполнятся автоматически. Готово к печати.
ru.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Измените текст здесь; слова в скобках подставляются из каждой строки. Ссылки находятся в таблицах.
ru.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Выберите запись — для каждого этапа появится срок. Создайте копию листа для каждой записи.
ru.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Актуальные диаграммы по данным ваших листов. Выберите значения в жёлтых ячейках — диаграммы и индикаторы обновятся автоматически.

nl.Fill Brand Clients with one row for each: Vul Merk klanten met één rij voor elk merk. Campagnes, budget, geld dat is toegewezen aan makers van inhoud en verkopen uit codes worden ingevuld vanaf de andere pagina's.
nl.Keep Rate Card up to date with the low a: Houd Tariefkaart op de hoogte van de lage en hoge prijs voor een bericht op elk platform en formaat van elke contentmaker. De gebruikelijke prijs en de gemiddelde vraag van uw makers van inhoud worden ingevuld.
nl.Add every creator on Creators with follo: Voeg elke contentmaker toe op Contentmakers met volgers, betrokkenheidspercentage en vraagpercentage. Via de prijscheck ziet u in één keer of het tarief boven of onder de tariefkaart ligt.
nl.Track every creator you approach on Outr: Volg elke contentmaker die u benadert op Outreach-pijplijn. De volgende stap laat zien wie een vervolgactie nodig heeft, en de kloof laat zien hoe ver uw aanbod verwijderd is van hun vraag.
nl.Write each campaign on Campaign Briefs w: Schrijf elke campagne op Creatieve instructies voor campagnes met het bijbehorende budget en leg vervolgens elke overeenkomst voor de makers van inhoud vast in Contracten. Gebruiksvergoeding, exclusiviteitsvergoeding, uw vergoeding, de einddatum van het gebruik en het nog verschuldigde bedrag vult u in.
nl.List every post a creator owes on Delive: Vermeld elk bericht dat de maker van de inhoud verschuldigd is op Afleveringen en elk concept op Goedkeuringen van inhoud. Dagen te laat, dagen wachten en de status worden ingevuld.
nl.Record every deposit and final payment o: Registreer elke storting en laatste betaling op Betalingen voor makers van inhoud. Achterstallige betalingen, nog verschuldigde bedragen en de dagen te laat invullen.
nl.Score each live post on Creator Results: Geef elke livepost op Resultaten van de maker van inhoud een score met het bereik en de reacties van het publiek om het betrokkenheidspercentage, de kosten voor elke betrokkenheid en de kosten voor 1000 bereikte mensen te bekijken.
nl.Add each code or tracked link on Codes a: Voeg elke code of bijgehouden link toe op Codes en koppelingen om de commissie, kortingskosten, omzet voor elke uitgegeven eenheid en het nettoresultaat te bekijken.
nl.Use Brand Fit, Follower Audits, Ad Label: Gebruik Merk pasvorm, Volgeraudits, Controles van advertentielabels en Exclusiviteit voordat u ondertekent en na elk bericht, en Feedback van de maker van de inhoud na elke campagne.
nl.Use Gifted Products, Event Appearances a: Gebruik Geschenkproducten, Optredens van evenementen en Ambassadors voor de andere manieren waarop u samenwerkt met makers van inhoud.
nl.Use the 14 calculators for rates, cost p: Gebruik de 14 calculators voor tarieven, kosten per opdracht, rendement, pasvorm, commissie, gebruiksrechten, betalingsschema's, budgetverdeling, doelgroepbereik, geschenken, exclusiviteit, shortlists, werkelijke doelgroepkosten en ambassadeurs.
nl.Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 1: Druk 10 vellen en 10 brieven af, volg 10 stapsgewijze checklists en tik op een berichtlink om WhatsApp te openen met de tekst gereed.
nl.Read Creators Dashboard and Charts every: Lees elke week Dashboard voor makers van inhoud en grafieken: achterstallige berichten en betalingen, beëindiging van gebruiksrechten, controles van advertentielabels, budget en resultaten.
nl.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle keuzelijsten in dit bestand. Wijzig hier een item en de wijziging wordt op elk werkblad doorgevoerd.

nl.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Kies in de gele cel; de rest wordt automatisch ingevuld. Klaar om af te drukken.

nl.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Kies een registratie: voor elke stap wordt de uiterste datum berekend. Maak voor elke registratie een kopie van dit werkblad.
nl.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Actuele grafieken op basis van je werkbladen. Kies in de gele cellen en alle grafieken en meters worden automatisch vernieuwd.
